confidence_notes: Beer, coffee, cocktail and inexpensive-meal anchors rest on Brno and Czech price points from crowd-sourced comparison sites, undated venue menus and travel guides. Those were converted at roughly 21-22 CZK per USD, as implied by the conversions in those sources; no live CZK rate was searched. The sources are mixed in date, so none is confirmed for July 2026 specifically. midrange_meal_2p and wine_glass are the least certain. The aggregator figures of about $14 for two people look low against local CZK menu points, so the estimate sits above them. No Brno restaurant wine-by-the-glass price was found, so wine_glass is bounded from the beer anchor (about 1.15x) with Prague and regional glass prices as cross-checks. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a mid-sized Czech city in summer. They were not checked against live listings or booking pages, and no accommodation search was run. FX 0.6720 for 2026-11-18 was taken from search-result snippets that attribute it to the RBA and to a third-party site; the rba.gov.au page itself was not opened, and no 2026-11-19 observation was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used for food and drink; the basis is Brno-specific Czech price points. Prague guides served only as a ceiling check for cocktails and wine glasses. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for Brno, benchmarked to typical Czech regional-city rates rather than a named comparable city.
